title: Homology of one filtered-complex quotient page
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], $K^\bullet$ an integer-indexed cochain complex, and $F$ a decreasing filtration by subcomplexes [def-sp-filtration]. Let $r\ge1$ and let D be differential data as specified in [lem-sp-filtered-complex-page-differential], on the concrete quotients $Q_r^{p,q}=Z_r^{p,q}/B_r^{p,q}$ [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients]. For every bidegree $(p,q)$ there is an isomorphism $H(D.\mathrm{page})^{p,q}\cong Q_{r+1}^{p,q}$. The next page differential is not assumed or constructed.

source.place: Tag 012K, displayed cycle, boundary and differential formulas and lemma-spectral-sequence-filtered-complex

proof.text: Compute the kernel of the outgoing representative differential. A class in Z_r/B_r is killed precisely when, locally along an epimorphism, its representative x has dx equal modulo F^(p+r+1) to dy for y in F^(p+1). Replacing x by x-y preserves its graded class and yields a representative in the (r+1)-cycles. Conversely such a representative is killed. Therefore the kernel is Z_(r+1)/B_r. The representative equation of D supplies the differential used in this calculation. Local lifting is pullback along an epimorphism, so no projectivity or elementwise assumption on the category is needed.

Compute the image of the incoming representative differential. Its source filtration degree is p-r. Its differential lands in F^p; this is exactly the defining incoming image for B_(r+1). Taking the image after projection into the page gives B_(r+1)/B_r, with both containments witnessed by the same representative equation and epimorphic local lifts.

Boundaries lie in cycles by the proved inclusion. Apply the abelian quotient-of-quotients isomorphism to the kernel modulo the incoming image: (Z_(r+1)/B_r)/(B_(r+1)/B_r) is Z_(r+1)/B_(r+1). It is the constructed cokernel Q_(r+1). Every operation is a finite subobject/image/cokernel operation.
